notes.title: Available on November 8th!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

We hope you're doing well! We finally have a release date to share with you! Saturnalia, will be launching on Steam this November 8th!

This release will introduce a few extra features:
[list]
[*]First Person mode: Now you can fully immerse yourself in the game by playing in first person! And if you prefer, you can even set it up to automatically switch to first person when inside buildings.
[*]Photo mode: Capture your favorite moments and share them with friends using our in-game photo mode, complete with FOV, roll, and post-processing options.
[*]Film Noir mode: Looking for a unique twist? Try our Film Noir mode, which transforms the game into a black and white noir movie experience (instead of Giallo!).
[/list]
here's a release date trailer showing the new modes: [previewyoutube=wERsTcYBTqA;full]https://youtu.be/wERsTcYBTqA[/previewyoutube]

We also care about your comfort while playing, so we've added accessibility features to help with motion sickness. These include camera responsiveness options and the ability to turn off the rotoscoping effect, allowing characters to animate at a smooth 60 fps.

We are also supporting cloud saves and achievements, of course <3 

To make sure you don't miss out on the release, and to help us get noticed on Steam, you can wishlist Saturnalia here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916350/Saturnalia/

We can't wait for you to play the game and tell us what you think! As always, thank you for your support, and see you on November 8th!

Pietro and the team at SR

PS Don't forget to check out the 40-minute demo!

PPS We are also working on a new Simplified Chinese translation, coming in early 2024. More details soon!

notes.title: Saturnalia is coming to Steam this year!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

We hope you're doing well! We have some fantastic news to share with you that we think you'll be excited about. Our third-person survival horror adventure, Saturnalia, will be launching on Steam later this year!

We've been working hard to create an immersive and thrilling gaming experience for you, and we're proud to introduce a few new features for the Steam release:
[list]
[*]First Person mode: Now you can fully immerse yourself in the game by playing in first person! And if you prefer, you can even set it up to automatically switch to first person when inside buildings.
[*]Photo mode: Capture your favorite moments and share them with friends using our in-game photo mode, complete with FOV, roll, and post-processing options.
[*]Film Noir mode: Looking for a unique twist? Try our Film Noir mode, which transforms the game into a black and white noir movie experience (instead of Giallo!).
[/list]
We also care about your comfort while playing, so we've added accessibility features to help with motion sickness. These include camera responsiveness options and the ability to turn off the rotoscoping effect, allowing characters to animate at a smooth 60 fps.

To make sure you don't miss out on the action, you can wishlist Saturnalia on Steam starting today!

And to give you a sneak peek of what's in store, check out our trailer highlighting the new features: [previewyoutube=Wu-dLkGwZd4;full]https://youtu.be/Wu-dLkGwZd4[/previewyoutube]

We can't wait for you to join us on this thrilling adventure! As always, thank you for your support, and we'll keep you updated on the latest news about Saturnalia's release.

Happy gaming!
